description: Apply a strategic shift to the project. Three modes: "capture" for lightweight mid-conversation decision capture (no LLM round-trip), "prepare" to get a change prompt for full analysis, "apply" to persist analysis output. Use "capture" when you detect a strategic decision in conversation and want to persist it quickly without disrupting the build flow. In "capture" mode, pass north_star to directly set/update the project North Star (no decision text needed).

ad_body.description: Full AD body in markdown format including ### heading (mode "capture" only). If omitted, a body is auto-generated from the text field.

ad_id.description: Existing AD ID to update (mode "capture" only). Omit to create a new AD.

confidence.description: Confidence level for the AD (mode "capture" only). Defaults to MEDIUM.

confidence_only.description: When true (mode "capture" + ad_id required), only update the confidence level — leave the AD body unchanged. Use when evidence strength changes but the decision itself hasn't shifted.

cycle_number.description: The cycle number from prepare phase (mode "apply" only).

decision_type.description: mode "capture" only — classifying dimension beyond confidence (task-3406/3408). Optional; an untyped AD stays "unclassified" rather than guessed at.

llm_response.description: Your raw output from executing the change prompt (mode "apply" only).

mode.description: "capture" for lightweight direct persistence (no LLM needed). "prepare" returns the change prompt. "apply" accepts your output. Defaults to "prepare" when omitted.

north_star.description: mode "capture" only — set/update the project North Star statement directly. orient and the project foundation read it. No decision text required when this is provided.

propose.description: mode "capture" only — write this decision as `proposed` rather than immediately `resolved`. Use when the project's decision_resolution_mode requires a resolve step (per_type/group) before this becomes binding. Resolve or withdraw it later with `decision_resolve`. Defaults false (today's behaviour — resolved immediately).

supersedes.description: Existing AD ID this new decision replaces, e.g. "AD-42" (mode "capture" only). The named AD is marked superseded and kept as history — never overwritten. Use this instead of passing ad_id when the decision has CHANGED rather than been refined.

text.description: Description of the strategic shift to apply (e.g. "Pivot from B2C to enterprise B2B").

name: strategy_change
